request.subject: ICON:ACTION:WAIL

layers.text: Change only the colours: the ghost head becomes pale bone-white, warm ivory shaded with warm grey, with no blue; its eyes and its open mouth glow bright violet; the sound rings and small sparks around it become bright glowing violet. Nothing blue is left. Keep the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
